def solve_region(g, region, tile):
    # region: (r0,r1,c0,c1) inclusive of zero-region bounds; tile anchored at tile_r0,tile_c0
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=region
    tr,tc,th,tw=tile
    P=[[g[tr+a][tc+b] for b in range(tw)] for a in range(th)]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            out[i][j]=P[(i-tr)%th][(j-tc)%tw]
    return out

def find_regions(g):
    # find connected nonzero-non8 pattern and enclosing zero rectangles
    import itertools
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cols=[(v not in (0,8)) for r in g for v in r]
    # flood fill on colored cells
    seen=set(); tiles=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] not in (0,8) and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; comp=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); comp.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and g[na][nb] not in (0,8):
                            st.append((na,nb))
                rs=[a for a,b in comp]; cs=[b for a,b in comp]
                tiles.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs)-min(cs)+1))
    return tiles

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    tiles=find_regions(g)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for tr,tc,th,tw in tiles:
        P=[[g[tr+a][tc+b] for b in range(tw)] for a in range(th)]
        # find zero region: expand rect around tile while neighbors rows/cols contain zeros
        r0,r1,c0,c1=tr,tr+th-1,tc,tc+tw-1
        # a row belongs to region if it contains any 0 adjacent-ish; simpler: expand while row above/below has zeros in c0..c1
        changed=True
        while changed:
            changed=False
            if r0>0 and any(g[r0-1][j]==0 for j in range(c0,c1+1)): r0-=1; changed=True
            if r1<h-1 and any(g[r1+1][j]==0 for j in range(c0,c1+1)): r1+=1; changed=True
            if c0>0 and any(g[i][c0-1]==0 for i in range(r0,r1+1)): c0-=1; changed=True
            if c1<w-1 and any(g[i][c1+1]==0 for i in range(r0,r1+1)): c1+=1; changed=True
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            for j in range(c0,c1+1):
                out[i][j]=P[(i-tr)%th][(j-tc)%tw]
    return out
